info.title: Hyperledger Cacti Plugin - CBDC Interoperability Controller
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the CBDC Interoperability Controller plugin. Exposes endpoints to initiate and accept cross-ledger CBDC transactions. Every request and successful response is a signed envelope; payload schemas describe the inner content that goes inside the envelope's `signed` field.

SignedEnvelope.description: HMAC-SHA256 signed envelope. `signed` is the base64 encoding of canonical bytes of the form `v1.<senderId>.<ts>.<nonce>.<payloadJson>` (request) or `v1.<senderId>.<requestNonce>.<payloadJson>` (response). `sig` is the HMAC of those canonical bytes computed with the partner's shared secret. `partnerId` identifies the sender of this envelope.

partnerId.description: Identifier of the partner that produced this envelope (caller on requests, controller on responses).

signed.description: Base64 of the canonical bytes that were signed.

sig.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical bytes, keyed by the partner's shared secret.

InitiateTransactionPayload.description: Inner payload of a signed initiate-transaction request.

sourceChainCode.description: Identifier of the source ledger / chain.

destinationChainCode.description: Identifier of the destination ledger / chain.

senderAddress.description: Address of the sender on the source chain.

receiverAddress.description: Address of the receiver on the destination chain.

amount.description: Amount of CBDC to transfer, denominated in the source asset.

timeToExpire.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which the transaction is considered expired.

complianceProviders.description: Identifiers of compliance endpoints that must approve the transaction.

InitiateTransactionResponsePayload.description: Inner payload of the signed initiate-transaction response.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier of the created transaction.

status.description: Optional status indicator. Present when the transaction requires manual review.

AcceptTransactionPayload.description: Inner payload of a signed accept-transaction request.

transactionId.description: Identifier of the transaction to accept.

AcceptTransactionResponsePayload.description: Inner payload of the signed accept-transaction response.

status.description: Final status of the accepted transaction.

ErrorResponse.description: Unsigned error response. 4xx/5xx responses are not enveloped because the sender's identity (or shared secret) may be unknown or in dispute.

error.description: Short machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_SIGNATURE, UNKNOWN_PARTNER, STALE_TIMESTAMP, REPLAYED_NONCE).

post.description: Submits a new CBDC transaction request to the controller for compliance evaluation and execution. The request body must be a `SignedEnvelope` whose inner payload is an `InitiateTransactionPayload`. The 200/202 response body is a `SignedEnvelope` whose inner payload is an `InitiateTransactionResponsePayload`, bound to the request's nonce.

200.description: Transaction created and accepted for processing.

202.description: Transaction created but marked for manual review.

401.description: Envelope signature missing, malformed, or unverifiable.

post.summary: Accept a transaction previously marked for review.
post.description: Confirms a transaction so the controller proceeds with execution. The request body must be a `SignedEnvelope` whose inner payload is an `AcceptTransactionPayload`. Only the partner that initiated the transaction may accept it. The 200 response body is a `SignedEnvelope` whose inner payload is an `AcceptTransactionResponsePayload`, bound to the request's nonce.

401.description: Envelope signature missing, malformed, or unverifiable.

403.description: Caller is not the initiator of the referenced transaction.
